title: Plausible Business to self-hosted Umami
summary: Umami is much lighter to run than Plausible Community Edition, which is the only reason this comparison reads differently from the other one.

you_lose: Plausible's polish, and its funnels and revenue tracking
A hosted service run by people who care about privacy analytics specifically
Email reports and shared dashboards without configuration
you_gain: Postgres or MySQL instead of ClickHouse, which is the difference between a 1 GB box and a 4 GB one

caveats: Historical data does not transfer. You start counting from zero unless you write the import yourself.
Plausible Cloud at $19 a month is genuinely cheap. This comparison exists because Umami is light enough to change the answer, not because $19 is outrageous.
Umami's reporting is thinner than Plausible's. If you actually read your analytics rather than just collecting them, that matters.
